newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Hotel, commerce stocks drag down Mauritius index.
newsitem.headline: Hotel, commerce stocks drag down Mauritius index.

text.p: The Mauritius bourse share index, semdex, lost 1.03 points to 325.71 on Monday reflecting a fall in share prices of leading companies in the hotel and commerce sectors, brokers said.
Volume transacted was down to 7.07 million rupees on 344,349 shares from 9.74 million rupees on 658,571 shares on Friday.
Brokers said the semdex fall reflected easing share prices of leading stocks in the hotel sector and of the country's second largest conglomerate, Ireland Blyth.

Ireland Blyth fell 80 cents to 12.20 rupees on 575 shares. In the hotel sector, New Mauritius Hotels eased 10 cents to 29.30 rupees on 5,000 shares and Sun Resorts was 50 cents lower to 34.50 rupees on 1,642 shares.
"This was sufficient to offset gains in other leading companies such as Air Mauritius," one dealer said.
Stocks of the national carrier rose 30 cents to 50 rupees on 5,000 shares and in the sugar sector, Mon Tresor Mon Desert rose 30 cents to 38 rupees on 5,000 shares.

Trading in the rest of the list remained hesitant as investors kept away ahead of an expected government cabinet reshuffle which Mauritian Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam promised for a close future, brokers said.
Shares in the financial sector remained stable on Monday. Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 73 rupees on 6,584 shares and State Bank of Mauritius remained at 8.80 rupees on 229,710 shares.
